record.question: Indian Air Force (IAF) and Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for astronaut selection and training which is known as:
record.explanation: Answer C: Gaganyaan Programme. The IAF–ISRO cooperation in the source question relates to the Gaganyaan human spaceflight programme. Reference: https://www.isro.gov.in/Gaganyaan.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
